scripts.build:packages: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/http build && bun run --cwd packages/postgres-adapter build && bun run --cwd packages/fastify-routes build && bun run --cwd packages/express-routes build
scripts.test:integration: bun run db:check:test && bun run db:reset:test && bun run db:migrate:test && bun test --max-concurrency=1 $(find packages -type f -path '*/test/integration/*.test.ts' | sort)
scripts.test:ci: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.pack:dry-run: export npm_config_cache=.tmp/npm-cache && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @luxledger/core && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @luxledger/http && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @luxledger/postgres-adapter && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @luxledger/fastify-routes && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @luxledger/express-routes
